mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.avatar_url, d.description, d.collection_name, d.file_size, d.multi_round, d.top_k, d.score, d.sort_order, d.fragment_size, d.empty_desc, d.sensitive_flag, d.sensitive_msg, d.welcome_msg, d.public_flag, d.public_password, d.embedding_model, d.summary_model, d.pre_summary, d.pre_compress, d.ai_ocr_flag, d.del_flag, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.create_by, d.update_by, d.footer, d.standard_flag, d.visibility, d.category, d.ai_tag_flag, d.tags, d.reranker_model, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_document doc WHERE doc.dataset_id = d.id AND doc.del_flag = '0') AS units FROM ai_dataset d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY d.create_time DESC
